head: Free ChatGPT Pro invite scam: fake OpenAI event page steals your logins
dek: A fake OpenAI Academy page invites you to a 4 November marketing livestream and promises three months of ChatGPT Pro, but it's built to steal Microsoft and Google logins, security firm Push Security found.
details: Similar fake pages copied a SpaceX briefing and an Anthropic session at AWS re:Invent. The links reach people through Google and Zapier short links, so they look harmless. None of the companies is behind them, and there's no free subscription.
means: If an invite promises free ChatGPT Pro for signing up to an event, it's likely this scam.
todo: Don't sign in with Microsoft or Google on a page you reached from an invite; go to openai.com yourself to check any offer.
thumb_words: FREE CHATGPT PRO? IT'S A SCAM
